interpretations.label: Nominal Net Worth
interpretations.description: The estimated net worth in current US dollars as published by Forbes in the specific annual billionaire ranking year.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Total estimated value of assets minus liabilities evaluated at market prices during the Forbes annual compilation window, measured in USD.
caveats: Does not account for inflation across different decades.
Stock prices and asset valuations fluctuate daily, making the annual snapshot date crucial.

interpretations.label: Inflation-Adjusted Net Worth
interpretations.description: The net worth adjusted for inflation to reflect constant purchasing power in a base target year (e.g., 2022 dollars).
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Nominal net worth adjusted using the US Consumer Price Index (CPI) to a common baseline year, measured in constant USD.
caveats: Inflation adjustments can vary depending on the consumer index or methodology used.
Asset-price inflation often outpaces general consumer price inflation.

knownRisks: Private wealth estimates involve significant opacity and reliance on self-reported or estimated asset values.
Methodological shifts by Forbes over the decades regarding family fortunes versus individuals (e.g., Walton family vs. Sam Walton).
